strings.preset_exists_overwrite_hint: A preset with this name already exists, it will be overwritten.
strings.preset_preview_note: Preview, your current loadout is only overwritten once you click Apply.
strings.dodge_agent_select_title: Leaves agent select, dodges the queue
strings.waiting_for_any: Waiting for VALORANT or League of Legends
strings.start_any_hint: Start VALORANT or League of Legends, RankYoinker detects the game automatically.
strings.start_valorant_vry_autostart: Start VALORANT, RankYoinker will launch automatically.
strings.vry_running_no_riot_html:
RankYoinker is running but can't reach the Riot Client (connection error, retrying).
Start VALORANT, RankYoinker will then connect automatically.
strings.match_already_running: The game is already running, RankYoinker will restart shortly so it can see the match.
strings.boot_hint_service: The service is restarting, this only takes a few seconds.
strings.boot_hint_lobby: You'll see yourself and your party here in a moment.
strings.vry_should_be_running_html: RankYoinker should be running. If a restart doesn't help, report it via {path}.
strings.port_unreachable_phone_html: Port {port} is not reachable from your phone. Check the firewall rule on your PC (setup\install_all.py).
strings.helper_service_unreachable_html: The helper service is not reachable (port 1101). Open RankYoinker once via the RankYoinker shortcut in the Start menu, then everything runs on its own.
strings.load_error_text_html:
RankYoinker ran into an error while loading the match data.
Feel free to report it via {path}.
strings.start_valorant_lobby_autoload: Start VALORANT, your lobby and match will appear automatically.
strings.valorant_open_vry_connecting: VALORANT is running, RankYoinker will connect in a moment.
strings.helper_service_unreachable_plain: The helper service is not reachable (port 1101), open RankYoinker via the Start menu shortcut.
strings.dodge_agent_select_title_full: Leaves agent select, dodges the queue, without closing VALORANT
strings.lol_not_running_hint: Start League of Legends. Once the client is running, everything will show up here automatically.
strings.party_confirmed_with_tip: In a party with {who}, confirmed directly by Riot.
strings.party_likely_with_tip: Probably playing with {who}: they were in the same party in {proof} of the last matches.
strings.party_alive_with_tip: Playing with {who}: same party in their last match, and Riot says that party still exists.
strings.computed_from_last_match_tip: Computed from the last match, RankYoinker didn't have a value.
strings.toast_connected_msg: RankYoinker is now delivering match data.
strings.toast_disconnected_msg: Lost the WebSocket connection to RankYoinker, reconnecting automatically.
strings.lock_too_early_msg: Short safety delay, same as Instalock, {n}s left.
strings.toast_need_new_qr: They will need a new QR code.
strings.toast_vry_started_msg: VALORANT is running, RankYoinker was launched automatically along with it.
strings.toast_vry_stopped_msg: VALORANT is closed, RankYoinker was closed automatically along with it.
strings.toast_vry_restarted_msg: The process had stopped, leftover instances were closed and RankYoinker was started fresh.
strings.toast_account_switched_msg: Names, loadout, presets and shop are being reloaded.
strings.procline_running: PROCESS RUNNING, WEBSOCKET NOT READY YET…
strings.procline_valorant_launching: VALORANT IS LAUNCHING, RANKYOINKER WILL START AUTOMATICALLY…
strings.procline_restarting: PROCESS GONE, AUTOMATIC RESTART IN PROGRESS…
strings.procline_auto_off: AUTOMATION PAUSED, RESUMES WITH THE NEXT VALORANT LAUNCH
strings.toast_instalock_enabled_msg: {name} will be locked after {span} in your next match, even if the tab is in the background or closed.
strings.update_new_version_generic: A new RankYoinker version is available.
strings.update_deferred_match: A match is running. The update will start automatically once you're back in the lobby.
strings.update_uac_hint: Windows will ask for admin rights in a moment – please confirm with "Yes".
strings.update_done_text: RankYoinker {version} is installed – the page reloads in a moment.
strings.update_slow: Taking longer than usual – did you confirm the Windows prompt?
strings.loadout_transferred_ingame: The loadout only transfers once the match is live (INGAME).
strings.loadout_pending: The loadout is still coming in, give Riot a moment.
strings.agent_lock_wait_hint: Short safety delay, same as Instalock.
strings.instalock_risk_checkbox_label: I understand the risks and want to continue
strings.no_unlocked_skins: No unlocked skins found for this weapon.
strings.lol_auto_ban_toggle: Run preset ban automatically (per lane, with fallback bans)
strings.lol_auto_pick_toggle: Run preset pick automatically (per lane, with fallback champions)
strings.lol_auto_accept_active: Automatic accept is on, RankYoinker normally handles this by itself.
strings.lol_live_unreachable: The client says the game is live, but live data isn't reachable yet.
strings.lol_waiting_client: Waiting for connection to the League client…
strings.lol_no_further_data: No further data available for this player (a lobby/match from someone else without an open identity).
strings.enc_badge_tip:
{games}× played together: {ally}× on the same team, {enemy}× against each other.
The detail view shows when and on which map.
strings.enc_badge_tip_lol:
{games}× played together: {ally}× on the same team, {enemy}× against each other.
The detail view shows when and in which queue.
strings.rr_too_few_matches: Not enough ranked matches for a chart yet.
strings.enc_older_counted_1: {n} older encounter was only counted, there's no log entry for it yet.
strings.enc_older_counted_n: {n} older encounters were only counted, there's no log entry for them yet.
strings.modal_no_puuid: No PUUID available for this player.
strings.stats_loading_riot: Loading match stats from the Riot API…
strings.stats_load_failed_hint: Open RankYoinker via the “RankYoinker” shortcut in the Start menu, then stats will work too.
strings.pair_no_network_found: No network address was found. Is the PC connected to WiFi or a cable?
strings.pair_no_code_active: No code active. Generate one to connect another device.
strings.pair_scan_instructions: Scan the code with your phone's camera. It needs to be on the same WiFi network as this PC. The code is single-use and expires after 5 minutes.
strings.pair_home_wifi_hint: Only pair on your own WiFi – on public networks (café, hotel, campus) others could read the connection.
strings.pair_permissions_note: A connected phone can do everything you can here, including dodging and instalock. Unpairing takes effect immediately.
strings.local_service_conn_failed: Could not connect to the local service.
strings.lol_auto_accept: Automatically accept when a match is found
strings.current_loadout_unreadable: Current loadout not readable right now
strings.save_preset_sub: Your current loadout with all 20 weapons will be saved under this name.
strings.shop_reload_title: Fetch the shop fresh from Riot now
strings.shop_item_not_cataloged_tip: Just added by Riot — name/image aren't in our data source yet (valorant-api.com), should fill in on its own within a few days.
strings.lol_auto_no_pick_left: None of your preset picks are available anymore – pick manually before the timer runs out!
strings.smurf_tip: Level {level}, last {games} ranked matches: K/D {kd}, {hs}% headshots, {wins} wins. Could also just be a strong new player.
strings.lol_presets_autos_desc: One target per lane plus two fallbacks. If the main pick is banned or taken, RankYoinker uses the next one.
strings.mu_apply_hint: Writes runes, spells and an item set to the client. You'll see the item set in the in-game shop.
strings.mu_unavailable: Builds are unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
strings.mu_no_build_data: There is no build data for this combination.
strings.mu_general_note: Not enough data for this matchup ({n} games) – showing the general builds for the lane.
strings.mu_no_opponent: Lane opponent not known yet – these are the general builds for the lane.
strings.mu_hover_hint: Hover or pick a champion – matching builds for your matchup will show up here.
strings.mu_build_wr_tip: Win rate and games with exactly this core build
strings.side_first_half_tip: Your side in the first half – sides swap at halftime.
strings.lol_autobuild_tip: After you lock in, automatically applies the most popular build against your lane opponent (runes, spells, item set) and updates it once the opponent is known. If you apply a build yourself, that one stays for the game.
strings.mu_auto_applied_general: Applied automatically: {opt} (general build, lane opponent not known yet)
strings.mu_live_note: League doesn't load a new item set during a game – use this build as your reference.
strings.mu_err_no_rune_page: No free rune page – delete one in the client or name a page “RankYoinker”.
strings.set_general_desc: Language and how player cards look.
strings.set_overlay_desc: Ranks, scoreboard and results right in the game.
strings.set_connect_desc: Pair your phone and join the community.
strings.set_pair_hint: Scan a QR code to use RankYoinker on your phone
strings.set_problem_hint: Describe a bug and send diagnostics
strings.instalock_desc: Pick an agent and turn on instalock: as soon as the next agent select starts, RankYoinker locks it in for you after a short, random delay.
strings.instalock_desc_keep: It stays on: after every match RankYoinker briefly asks whether to keep going with the agent.
strings.instalock_ask_body: Should Instalock lock {name} in the next match too? No answer pauses it.
strings.instalock_ask_skip: Don't ask for the next {n} matches
strings.instalock_ingame_html: {name} locked, you'll be asked after the match
strings.instalock_ask_open_html: Waiting for your answer: keep going with {name}?
strings.instalock_paused_html: Paused, no answer after the match
strings.toast_instalock_paused_msg: No answer after the match. Turn it back on to continue.
strings.toast_instalock_paused_closed_msg: VALORANT was closed. Turn it back on to continue.
strings.toast_instalock_paused_account_msg: Account switched. Turn it back on to continue.
strings.toast_instalock_continue_msg: {name} will be locked again in the next match.
strings.toast_instalock_continue_free_msg: {name} will be locked for the next {n} matches without asking.
strings.instalock_risk_fact_delay: Locks your agent after a random 11–12 seconds, within normal human reaction times and without an unfair advantage.
strings.instalock_risk_fact_instant: Tools that lock instantly (under 1 second) are considered cheat-like and can get you banned.
strings.instalock_risk_fact_residual: Any automation carries some residual risk with Riot. Use it at your own responsibility.
strings.loading_riot_pause: Riot is throttling requests right now – continuing in {s} s
strings.report_no_highlights: No standout moments this time – next game!
strings.lol_report_perf_explain: The grade compares your KDA, kill participation, damage, gold, CS and vision with the other players – supports are judged more on vision and participation.
strings.lol_banner_tagline: Ranks, stats & match analysis for League of Legends
strings.report_share_sub: Save it or share it right away – for example on Discord.
strings.report_share_up_fail_copied: Couldn't create a link – the image is on your clipboard.
strings.report_share_up_fail: Couldn't create a link – save the image instead.
strings.report_share_note: Sharing stores the image publicly on rankyoinker.de (accessible via link, 30 days).
strings.report_banner_tagline: Ranks, stats & match analysis for VALORANT
strings.problem_sub: Briefly describe what isn't working and when it happens. Your report goes straight to the RankYoinker team.
strings.problem_placeholder: What happened? For example: ranks stopped loading after the last update.
strings.problem_attach_logs_hint: The last lines of the RankYoinker log, without passwords and Windows user names. Helps a lot with troubleshooting.
strings.problem_err_busy: A report was just sent. Please try again in a few minutes.
strings.problem_err_offline: rankyoinker.de can't be reached right now. Check your connection and try again.
strings.report_perf_explain: The grade compares your ACS, K/D, ADR and KAST with the other players in this match.
strings.report_avg_note: Colored values: compared to your last {n} matches
strings.perf_mode_hint: Fewer effects, smooth instead – for weaker PCs or without hardware acceleration.
strings.perf_hint_msg: This device can barely keep up with the effects (e.g. without hardware acceleration). Performance mode runs much smoother.
strings.perf_on_msg: You can turn it off anytime in Settings under “Display”.
strings.toast_loadout_not_updated: Loadout not updated – showing last state
strings.ovl_master_hint: Small windows right on top of VALORANT. Only visible in borderless fullscreen or windowed mode.
strings.ovl_opt_pregame_hint: Ranks, peaks and parties before the match starts
strings.ovl_opt_board_hint: All players with ranks while you hold the key – just like the scoreboard.
strings.ovl_opt_result_hint: Grade, K/D/A and RR right after the game
strings.ovl_preview_toast_msg: The three windows now appear one after another on your screen.
strings.usage_stats_hint: Which features are used, plus error reports – no Riot ID. Off: only version and language are sent.
strings.risk_fact_pick: Controls agent select through an unofficial Riot interface – only after 11 seconds, like a human would.
strings.risk_fact_dodge: Leaves agent select through an unofficial Riot interface. Riot's normal dodge penalties (RR, queue timeout) apply.
strings.risk_fact_lol_accept: Automatically accepts found games in the League client – an automation Riot doesn't officially allow.
strings.risk_fact_lol_auto: Automatically bans or picks from your presets in champ select – an automation Riot doesn't officially allow.
strings.risk_fact_skins: Changes your loadout through an unofficial Riot interface – cosmetic only, no advantage in game.
strings.risk_fact_asia: One user reported a 3-day ban on Asia-Pacific servers (unconfirmed). We advise against these features there. We know of no case on EU or Korean (KR) accounts.
strings.match_view_unavailable: Riot no longer provides this match, or it belongs to another account.
strings.il_random_tip: Locks a random agent you own – you only see who it is after the lock.
